objects.name: Attack Flow
objects.description: Extends STIX 2.1 with features to create Attack Flows.

objects.name: Detection technique coverage: suspicious-linux-discovery-commands
objects.description: The following analytic detects the execution of suspicious bash commands commonly used in scripts like AutoSUID, LinEnum, and LinPeas for system discovery on a Linux host. It leverages Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) data, specifically looking for a high number of distinct commands executed within a short time frame. This activity is significant as it often precedes privilege escalation or other malicious actions. If confirmed malicious, an attacker could gain detailed system information,
